payload.name: Who What Wear
payload.description: 为你量身定制的编辑精选
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.
payload.longDescription:
Who What Wear 将女性时尚刊物的编辑风格带入 ChatGPT。设置简短的风格档案后，它就像一位熟悉你品味的造型师；你提出任何时尚问题，它都能给出了解品牌、符合你风格的回答，而不是泛泛而谈。

设置约需 1 分钟。一个引导式四步小组件会询问你的风格关键词（Low-Key Luxury、Tailored、French、Sporty、Trend-Forward 等）、你常购买的当代时尚、奢侈品、牛仔和配饰品牌、你愿意借鉴其造型的风格偶像，以及你能接受的价格范围。档案按用户保存，因此会在不同对话间保留，不必每次打开 ChatGPT 都从头开始。

完成设置后，有三项功能会派上用场。

挑选特定商品。告诉应用你在找什么——“帮我找一件 250 英镑以下的黑色西装外套”“我需要一件参加冬季婚礼的大衣”“我该买什么牛仔裤”——它会优先推荐你平时购买的品牌，从中选出 3 到 5 件商品，并围绕该商品搭配完整造型：上装、下装、鞋履和一两件配饰。目标是给你可直接穿着的搭配建议，而不是一串链接。

编辑灵感。询问你现在应该穿什么或关注什么，应用就会从 Who What Wear UK 的实时编辑内容流中获取新文章，再根据每篇文章的品牌和类别标签，挑出两三篇符合你品味的内容。精选内容会以横向卡片轮播形式呈现，采用刊物自己的视觉风格：编辑图片、引题、标题、署名以及直接返回 whowhatwear.com 原文的链接。

完善个人档案。品味会变化。重新打开引导设置即可更新任意答案（只改你想改的内容），也可以在重新开始时彻底重置档案。

有几点需要了解。编辑内容流来自 Who What Wear UK，因此内容的表达方式、货币和季节性都偏英国风格。推荐始终以真实的 Who What Wear 文章或根据你提供的品牌列表给出的建议为依据；应用不会为了填充结果而编造 URL、图片或文章，只有在有真实链接和图片可用时才会显示轮播。如果某天内容流里没有相关内容，应用会如实告知，而不会捏造信息。

应用不涵盖男装、美妆产品搜索、家居装饰或非时尚类购物，也不提供零售商实时库存或实时价格。如果请求超出范围，应用会明确说明，而不会猜测。

由 Future PLC（Who What Wear 的出版商）打造。

payload.name: Daft.ie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

• Show me 3-bedroom houses for sale in Cork under €450,000 on a map
• Find 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Dublin 8 under €500,000
• I’m looking for a detached home over 100 square metres in Galway
• Show me new builds in Limerick under €400,000
• Find me properties for sale in Wexford

From budget and bedroom count to property type, BER rating, and specific locations, Daft.ie makes exploring what’s for sale in Ireland clear and efficient - all through natural conversation.

Daft.ie 是爱尔兰领先的房产平台，可将房屋搜索直接带入 ChatGPT 对话。使用自然语言查找爱尔兰各地待售房产——无需表单和筛选器，只需简单对话。

在聊天中浏览带照片、描述、价格和互动地图的房源。以轮播方式查看结果，也可以在地图上查看房屋位置，快速了解地段、社区情况和周边设施。

• 查找 Dublin 8 售价低于 €500,000 的 2 居室待售公寓

• 显示 Limerick 售价低于 €400,000 的新建房屋
• 帮我查找 Wexford 的待售房产

从预算、卧室数量到房产类型、BER 能效评级和具体地点，Daft.ie 都能通过自然对话，让你清晰高效地探索爱尔兰待售房产。

The system is built on the same fishing logic used in the Angler Adventures mobile game, where players learn how bass behavior changes based on environment and conditions. Instead of endless gear lists or vague advice, you get ranked recommendations and clear guidance on how to fish each lure.

系统基于 Angler Adventures 手机游戏中使用的相同钓鱼逻辑。在游戏里，玩家了解鲈鱼行为如何随环境和条件变化。此配套应用将同一个决策引擎用于真实钓鱼，采用游戏中相同的环境逻辑和原创美术素材。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the motos.net marketplace to search for new, used, and classic motorbikes. This app allows you to filter listings by make, model, price, year, and location. payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Liftosaur is a scriptable workout app. It uses language "Liftoscript" to define workouts. The plugin lets users to write and manage Liftoscript programs, workout history, exercises, gym equipment, measurements, etc.

Liftosaur 是一款可编程训练应用，使用名为“Liftoscript”的语言定义训练。该插件允许用户编写和管理 Liftoscript 程序、训练历史、动作、健身房器材、测量数据等。

payload.name: Luxauto
payload.description: 购买或租赁汽车和摩托车
payload.summaryOriginal: Cars and moto to buy and lease
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Luxauto helps you find cars and motorcycles to buy or lease in a simple, conversational way. Just describe what you’re looking for — budget, type of vehicle, or lifestyle needs — and Luxauto will guide you with relevant suggestions and listings from the largest vehicle selection in Luxembourg and the Greater Region (France, Belgium, and Germany).

Whether you’re searching for a family car, a city vehicle, or something more specific, the app helps you explore options, refine your criteria, and quickly access matching offers from the Luxauto marketplace.

Designed to make vehicle search easier, faster, and more intuitive.
payload.longDescription:
Luxauto 以简单的对话方式帮助你寻找购买或租赁的汽车和摩托车。只需描述需求——预算、车辆类型或生活方式——Luxauto 就会从卢森堡及大区（法国、比利时和德国）最大的车辆选择中，为你提供相关建议和房源。

无论你寻找家庭用车、城市车辆还是更具体的车型，该应用都能帮助你探索选项、细化条件，并快速访问 Luxauto 市场中匹配的报价。

专为让车辆搜索更轻松、更快速、更直观而设计。

payload.name: Municibid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search active Municibid government surplus auctions, review sold comps, and get rough market value estimates based on historical auction results.
payload.longDescription: 搜索正在进行的 Municibid 政府剩余物资拍卖，查看已售同类品，并根据历史拍卖结果获得粗略的市场价值估算。

payload.name: Autovit.ro
payload.description: 在 Autovit 寻找你的理想汽车
payload.summaryOriginal: Find your dream car in Autovit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your dream car in Romania using everyday language. Skip the complex filters and search forms. With Autovit, simply describe what you're looking for - "SUV with low mileage, great for family of 4" or "recent model, city car."

Key features:

1. Advanced Search: Describe your ideal car in natural language
2. Relevant results: Get matches for your search
3. Interactive refinement: Ask follow-up questions to narrow your search 

Whether you're a first-time buyer or seasoned car enthusiast, Autovit makes car buying as simple as having a conversation.
payload.longDescription:
用日常语言在罗马尼亚寻找你的理想汽车。跳过复杂的筛选器和搜索表单。通过 Autovit，只需描述你的需求——“低里程 SUV，适合 4 人家庭”或“新款城市用车”。

主要功能：

1. 高级搜索：用自然语言描述你的理想汽车
2. 相关结果：获得匹配搜索需求的结果
3. 互动优化：通过追问缩小搜索范围

无论你是首次买车，还是经验丰富的汽车爱好者，Autovit 都让买车像聊天一样简单。

payload.name: Burger King
payload.description: 查找 BK 门店和优惠
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
With the official BURGER KING® app, explore our menu and find your nearest BK® restaurant anytime, anywhere. And in most locations, you can even order ahead.

Specific features include:
- Find your BK®: Locate your nearest BURGER KING® restaurant and never leave those flame-grilled cravings unfulfilled.
- Offers: Discover the hottest offers and deals right from your mobile device.
- Menu: Explore your BK® favorites and discover our hottest new menu additions. Plus, you can browse item descriptions at any time.
payload.longDescription:
使用 BURGER KING® 官方应用，随时随地浏览菜单并查找最近的 BK® 餐厅。大多数地点还支持提前点餐。

具体功能包括：
- 查找 BK®：定位最近的 BURGER KING® 餐厅，满足你对火烤美味的渴望。
- 优惠：直接在移动设备上发现热门优惠和折扣。
- 菜单：浏览你喜爱的 BK® 美食，发现最新热门菜单新品。你还可以随时查看商品介绍。

payload.name: atHome
payload.description: 寻找可买或可租的房产
payload.summaryOriginal: Find properties to buy or rent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
atHome.lu, Luxembourg’s leading real estate platform, now integrates directly into your ChatGPT experience.

Search for apartments, houses, and investment opportunities using natural language — just describe what you’re looking for. Browse listings with photos, pricing, and key details directly in the chat, displayed in a smooth carousel format.

Try prompts like:
- Show me 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Luxembourg City under €1,700
- Find houses for sale in Bettembourg with a garden under €1.5M
- I’m looking for a penthouse with an open view in Ettelbruck
- Show traditional farmhouses to renovate in Diekirch

Whether you’re filtering by budget, size, location, or specific features, atHome.lu helps you instantly explore real estate opportunities across Luxembourg and the Greater Region — all within the flow of your conversation.
payload.longDescription:
卢森堡领先的房地产平台 atHome.lu 现已直接融入你的 ChatGPT 体验。

使用自然语言搜索公寓、住宅和投资机会——只需描述你要找的房产。直接在聊天中浏览包含照片、价格和关键详情的房源，以流畅的轮播形式展示。

试试这样提问：
- 给我看看 Luxembourg City 租金低于 €1,700 的 2 卧室公寓
- 查找 Bettembourg 带花园、售价低于 €1.5M 的住宅
- 我想在 Ettelbruck 找一套视野开阔的顶层公寓
- 展示 Diekirch 可供翻新的传统农舍

无论按预算、面积、位置还是具体特色筛选，atHome.lu 都能帮助你即时探索卢森堡及大区各地的房地产机会——一切都在对话中完成。

payload.name: foodora
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
foodora lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodora app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

This is only available in Sweden for now; other countries are coming soon.
payload.longDescription:
foodora 帮助用户发现附近的外卖餐厅、搜索商家和菜品，并浏览完整菜单，包括价格、评分、配送时间估算和有效促销。每条结果都包含深层链接，方便用户继续在 foodora 应用或网站上点餐。结果以交互式商家和菜单卡片呈现。

Sellers prepare Excel-based listings in Talos; buyers discover available stock and contact sellers. Business verification is required for marketplace actions.
payload.longDescription: Digimarket 帮助经过验证的企业搜索和发布过剩工业库存，可按 OEM 零件号、品牌、类别、数量、单位和价格查找电缆、端子、连接器等；市场操作需要企业验证。

payload.name: Le Parisien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Accédez aux informations du Parisien : retrouvez les dernières actualités, recherchez des articles et suivez nos directs des grands événements facilement depuis ChatGPT.

Une façon simple et rapide de rester informé de l’actualité avec Le Parisien
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中访问 Le Parisien 新闻：轻松获取最新消息、搜索文章，并关注重大事件的实时报道。

通过 Le Parisien，以简单快捷的方式了解最新资讯。

payload.name: Rentals.ca Rental Search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Canadian rental listings by city or nearby landmark and view matching apartments, homes, prices, photos, and locations in ChatGPT. Users can search by city, apply common filters such as rent, beds, baths, parking, pets, furnished status, lease terms, availability, and verified listings, or search near a landmark, university, building, or station. Results include concise listing summaries for ChatGPT and an interactive widget with listing cards, a map, pagination, and links back to Rentals.ca listing pages.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中按城市或附近地标搜索加拿大租赁房源，并查看匹配公寓、住宅、价格、照片和位置。用户可按城市搜索，应用租金、卧室数、浴室数、停车位、宠物、家具配置、租约条款、可入住时间和已验证房源等常用筛选条件，也可搜索地标、大学、建筑或车站附近的房源。结果包含简明房源摘要，便于 ChatGPT 展示，并提供带房源卡片、地图、分页和 Rentals.ca 房源页面链接的交互式组件。

payload.name: Access Yami
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access Yami helps users shop the largest Asian grocery & lifestyle store in North America directly inside ChatGPT. Users can take a Brand Taste Identity (BTI) quiz to discover their snack persona and get personalized picks, search and browse 10,000+ products by keyword, category, or brand, see trending best-sellers, link their Yami account, add items to their real Yami cart, and get a checkout link to complete purchase on yami.com.
payload.longDescription: Access Yami 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中选购北美最大的亚洲食品和生活用品商店的商品。用户可以参加 Brand Taste Identity（BTI）测试，发现自己的零食偏好类型并获取个性化推荐；按关键词、类别或品牌搜索和浏览 10,000+ 件商品；查看热门畅销品；关联 Yami 账号；将商品添加到真实的 Yami 购物车；获取结账链接，在 yami.com 完成购买。

payload.name: CellFusion C
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CellFusion C helps users find CellFusionC skincare products that match their skin type, concerns, preferred texture, use case, and requested category. It searches the Cafe24 product catalog, ranks suitable products, and displays recommendation cards with product images, prices, purchase links, and concise guidance.
payload.longDescription: CellFusion C 帮助用户根据肤质、肌肤问题、偏好的质地、使用场景和指定类别，查找合适的 CellFusionC 护肤产品。它会搜索 Cafe24 商品目录、为适合的产品排序，并显示包含商品图片、价格、购买链接和简明建议的推荐卡片。

payload.name: Bites
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bites is an AI-native ordering platform that lets people discover restaurants, browse full menus, and place direct orders from local restaurants — all from ChatGPT, without switching to a delivery app.

Customers get the convenience of AI-powered ordering while seeing in-store menu pricing, with no markups or hidden fees. They can search by cuisine or location, ask for recommendations, customize meals, and build group orders in natural language.

Examples:

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.
payload.longDescription:
Bites 是一个 AI 原生点餐平台，让人们直接在 ChatGPT 中发现餐厅、浏览完整菜单，并向本地餐厅直接下单，无需切换到外卖应用。

顾客可以享受 AI 点餐的便利，同时看到店内菜单价格，没有加价或隐藏费用。他们可以按菜系或位置搜索、寻求推荐、定制餐点，并用自然语言组合多人订单。

示例：

“从 San Jose 的 Popeyes 点餐。”
“从 Mendocino Farms 点 2 份 Not So Fried Chicken 三明治，不要酱汁，使用无麸质面包。”
“从 Boltiful Santa Clara 为 10 人组合一份适合素食者的办公室午餐订单，每人低于 $20。添加几份甜点供团队分享。”
“给我看看 Curry Up Now 的菜单，帮我挑点辣的。”

对餐厅而言，Bites 支持 AI 驱动的直接点餐，不收佣金、不加价，餐厅完整掌握客户关系。餐厅可以减少对第三方外卖应用的依赖，同时保住利润，并通过顾客已经使用的渠道为他们服务。

简而言之，Bites 将外卖应用的便利与直接向餐厅点餐的经济优势相结合。

payload.name: LFmall
payload.description: 发现让你成为自己的品味，LFmall AI 购物
payload.summaryOriginal: 나를 나답게 만드는 취향 발견, LFmall AI 쇼핑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
복잡한 검색 대신 대화로 쇼핑하세요. LFmall은 당신의 스타일과 상황(TPO)을 이해하여 가장 '나다운' 패션과 라이프스타일 아이템을 찾아드립니다.
수만 개의 프리미엄 브랜드 상품 중 당신에게 딱 맞는 상품을 즉시 추천 받고, 공식몰만의 안전한 배송과 단독 혜택까지 한 번에 경험해 보세요. 
단순한 구매를 넘어 당신의 취향을 깊이 있게 완성해 드립니다.
payload.longDescription:
告别复杂搜索，用对话来购物。LFmall 能理解你的风格和场景（TPO），为你找到最符合“自我风格”的时尚与生活用品。
从数万件高端品牌商品中，即时为你推荐最合适的商品，还能一次享受官方商城的安心配送和独家优惠。
不止于购买，更深入地完善你的个人品味。

payload.name: Pararius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: With Pararius, everyone can easily find the right home. Open the site or app and search the Netherlands' largest private-sector housing offering in just a few seconds. Type a city, neighbourhood or postcode to discover properties, use filters to refine listings by price, surface area, number of rooms or furnishing, set alerts to be the first to know about new homes and contact the agent directly. An intuitive platform to use, even without experience in the Dutch rental market. Search for the home that fits you, from studios and apartments in Amsterdam to family houses in Apeldoorn.
payload.longDescription: 借助 Pararius，每个人都能轻松找到合适的家。打开网站或应用，只需几秒即可搜索荷兰最大的私人住房市场。输入城市、街区或邮政编码发现房源，按价格、面积、房间数量或家具配置筛选，设置提醒以第一时间获知新房，并直接联系中介。即使没有荷兰租赁市场经验，也能直观使用。从阿姆斯特丹的单间和公寓到阿珀尔多伦的家庭住宅，找到适合你的家。

payload.name: DEWA
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
DEWA (Dubai Electricity & Water Authority) App in ChatGPT makes it easy to check your outstanding amount and pay instantly using EasyPay, explore DEWA services, find nearby EV Green Charger locations with availability, and locate DEWA Customer Happiness Centers. Connect to DEWA through ChatGPT for quick, seamless access to the information and services you need, anytime.

تطبيق هيئة كهرباء ومياه دبي على ChatGPT يسهّل عليك التحقق من المبالغ المستحقة وسدادها فورًا من خلال خدمة الدفع السهل، والاطلاع على خدمات الهيئة، وتحديد مواقع شواحن المركبات الكهربائية القريبة وتوافرها، بالإضافة إلى تحديد مواقع مراكز إسعاد المتعاملين التابعة للهيئة. اربط الآن مع هيئة كهرباء ومياه دبي عبر ChatGPT للوصول السريع والسلس إلى المعلومات والخدمات التي تحتاجها في أي وقت.

payload.name: CarsGuide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for cars currently listed for sale across Australia and read expert reviews to help you decide. Browse thousands of new and used car listings by make, model, location, price range, and more — or just describe what you're looking for in plain language. Each result includes price, odometer, photos, and a direct link to the full listing. You can also find editorial reviews with expert ratings to compare models before you buy.
payload.longDescription: 搜索澳大利亚当前在售的汽车，并阅读专家评测，帮助你做出决定。按品牌、车型、地点、价格范围等条件浏览数千条新车和二手车信息，也可以直接用日常语言描述需求。每条结果都包含价格、里程表读数、照片以及完整车辆信息的直接链接。你还可以查看带专家评分的编辑评测，在购车前比较不同车型。

payload.name: UltraFit360
payload.description: 你的 AI 健身教练
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.
payload.longDescription: UltraFit360 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人健身和营养数据。你可以询问本周吃了什么、体重趋势如何、记录了哪些训练，或索取完整进展报告；回答直接来自 UltraFit360 饮食日记、训练记录、身体指标和 AI 教练记忆。经你确认后，它还可以记录你吃过的餐食、调整每日卡路里、宏量营养素、饮水量和步数目标、规划餐食、更换训练动作，以及分配或创建训练计划。你的身份完全依据已验证的登录会话，因此应用只会访问你自己的数据。UltraFit360 由 Aptix Labs Private Limited 运营；有关连接器数据的处理方式，请参阅 https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy。

payload.name: Historial de Vehiculos España
payload.description: 按车牌查询西班牙车辆数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Consulta gratis los datos básicos de cualquier coche matriculado en España a partir de su matrícula: marca, modelo, año, combustible, tipo de vehículo, cilindrada y potencia. Datos de fuentes oficiales. Si necesitas el informe COMPLETO (historial de ITV, kilometraje, titulares, cargas, valoración de mercado, robos y daños) la app te enlaza directamente al informe premium en analytics.transferautoonline.com.
payload.longDescription: 根据车牌免费查询任何在西班牙登记车辆的基本数据：品牌、车型、年份、燃料、车辆类型、排量和功率。数据来自官方来源。如果需要完整报告（ITV 年检历史、里程、车主、抵押或其他负担、市场估值、盗抢和损坏记录），应用会直接链接到 analytics.transferautoonline.com 上的付费高级报告。

payload.name: GrailPeople Shopping
payload.description: 查找真实可信的产品评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search 7,000+ skincare, makeup, and hair products by ingredient, concern, or skin type, and get shopping recommendations. GrailPeople shows what beauty experts actually say, including estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty content creators. Every review comes with quotes, video timestamps, and creator credentials.
payload.longDescription: 按成分、关注问题或肤质搜索 7,000 多种护肤、彩妆和护发产品，并获取购物建议。GrailPeople 展示美容专家的真实观点，包括美容师、化妆师和美容内容创作者。每条评价都附有引述、视频时间戳和创作者资历。

payload.name: Able.Style
payload.description: 适应各种天气的穿搭灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Able.Style is a personal fashion and style assistant that helps you decide what to wear using clothes from your own closet, the occasion, and local weather conditions.

Ask questions like “What should I wear today?”, “What should I wear for a casual work day?” or “What outfit works for cold and rainy weather?” Get complete outfit ideas with specific clothing items and visual fashion inspiration for work, weekends, events, hot weather, cold weather, rain, and changing forecasts.

Weather-aware outfit recommendations use the location saved in your Able.Style account when you’re signed in, or the location you share with ChatGPT. You can also choose your preferred temperature and wind speed units.

When you sign in, you can add clothes you own to your closet and like or dislike outfits to refine future style suggestions. Able.Style personalizes fashion recommendations based on your wardrobe and past preferences.

It’s a simple way to save time, avoid outfit guesswork, develop your personal style, and make better use of the clothes you already have.
payload.longDescription:
Able.Style 是个人时尚与穿搭助手，根据你的衣橱、场合和当地天气情况，帮助你决定穿什么。

可以询问“今天该穿什么？”、“休闲工作日该穿什么？”或“寒冷多雨的天气适合什么搭配？”。获取包含具体单品的完整穿搭建议和视觉时尚灵感，适用于工作、周末、活动、炎热、寒冷、下雨以及变化中的天气预报。

结合天气的穿搭建议会在你登录时使用 Able.Style 账号中保存的位置，或使用你向 ChatGPT 提供的位置。你还可以选择偏好的温度和风速单位。

登录后，你可以将已有衣物添加到衣橱，并对搭配点赞或点踩，优化未来的穿搭建议。Able.Style 根据你的衣橱和以往偏好提供个性化时尚推荐。

这是一种简单的方法，帮你节省时间、避免猜测搭配、发展个人风格，并更充分地利用已有衣物。

payload.name: Wild Calf Coffee
payload.description: 找到好咖啡并改善冲煮
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tell Wild Calf Coffee how you brew and what you enjoy. It matches you to current coffees using catalog details and Wild Calf tasting and brewing information, explains why each suggestion fits, and says when a lot-specific detail has not been verified. It can troubleshoot weak, bitter, sour, or inconsistent coffee before recommending a purchase. When you are ready, it prepares a one-time Shopify cart. You review price, shipping, tax, and payment in Shopify; the plugin does not place or charge an order in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 告诉 Wild Calf Coffee 你的冲煮方式和口味偏好。它会根据商品目录详情以及 Wild Calf 的品鉴和冲煮信息，为你匹配当前在售咖啡，解释每项推荐为何适合你，并指出尚未核实的批次特定信息。它可以先帮你排查咖啡寡淡、苦、酸或风味不稳定等问题，再推荐购买。准备好后，它会生成一次性 Shopify 购物车。你可在 Shopify 查看价格、运费、税费并付款；该插件不会在 ChatGPT 中下单或扣款。

payload.name: Pearl Auto
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
People often have questions about their vehicle's symptoms, repair needs, or maintenance schedules but don't have immediate access to a qualified mechanic or automotive expert.

Pearl Auto has licensed automotive technicians and mechanics review AI answers. Each AI answer is clearly marked by the expert as correct or incorrect so users can quickly understand whether the information can be trusted.

Automotive specialists across multiple areas review responses, including general automotive repair, diesel trucks, transmission & drivetrain, brakes & suspension, electrical systems, engine diagnostics, HVAC & climate control, and body & paint.

This app is designed for informational guidance only and does not replace professional automotive service.

Users can:
- Ask AI questions about vehicle symptoms, repair procedures, and maintenance
- See whether a certified mechanic marked the AI response as correct or incorrect
- Get reassurance in the moment when an in-person mechanic is unavailable
payload.longDescription:
人们经常会对车辆症状、维修需求或保养周期有疑问，但无法立即联系到合格的机械师或汽车专家。

Pearl Auto 聘请持证汽车技师和机械师审核 AI 答案。专家会明确标记每条 AI 答案为正确或不正确，让用户迅速判断信息是否可信。

来自多个领域的汽车专家会审核回答，包括一般汽车维修、柴油卡车、变速箱与传动系统、制动与悬架、电气系统、发动机诊断、暖通空调与温控，以及车身与喷漆。

此应用仅提供信息参考，不可替代专业汽车维修服务。

用户可以：
- 询问车辆症状、维修流程和保养方面的问题
- 查看认证技师是否将 AI 回答标记为正确或不正确
- 在无法联系到现场技师时及时获得安心参考

payload.name: Rakhys
payload.description: 查找最佳电子产品价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Rakhys helps users compare electronics prices across major online stores in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

The app brings together product prices, specifications, and availability in one place, making it easier to find the best option before purchasing.

Rakhys provides:

Daily updated prices from multiple online retailers

Clear comparison of product specifications

AI-powered recommendations based on user needs

A simple and fast interface for smart shopping decisions

Rakhys is designed to save users time and money by helping them make informed buying decisions.

该插件查找最佳电子产品价格。以下功能和限制适用：

Rakhys helps users compare electronics prices across major online stores in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.

Rakhys is designed to save users time and money by helping them make informed buying decisions.

payload.name: broadbandnow.com
payload.description: 比较本地互联网服务提供商
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Broadbandnow.com makes finding the right internet service provider effortless. Simply tell ChatGPT your ZIP code or city, and instantly see available ISP plans with pricing, speeds, and ratings in beautiful interactive displays.

🔍 FIND PROVIDERS INSTANTLY
Search by ZIP code (like "91326") or city name (like "Los Angeles, California"). We'll show you every major internet provider serving your area - AT&T, Xfinity, Spectrum, Frontier, Starlink, and more.

⚡ REAL-TIME DATA
Powered by broadbandnow, America's leading source for ISP data. Get accurate pricing, actual speeds, and verified customer ratings from thousands of real reviews.

✨ WHAT YOU'LL SEE
- Provider brand information
- Star ratings based on real customer reviews
- Monthly pricing for different speed tiers
- Service types (Fiber, Cable, 5G, DSL)
- Direct links to shop or call providers
payload.longDescription:
Broadbandnow.com 让你轻松找到合适的互联网服务提供商。只需告诉 ChatGPT 你的邮政编码或城市，即可通过精美的交互式展示立即查看可用 ISP 套餐、价格、速度和评分。

🔍 即时查找服务商
按邮政编码（例如“91326”）或城市名称（例如“Los Angeles, California”）搜索。我们会列出服务你所在地区的所有主要互联网服务商——AT&T、Xfinity、Spectrum、Frontier、Starlink 等。

⚡ 实时数据
数据由美国领先的 ISP 数据来源 broadbandnow 提供。获取准确价格、实际网速，以及根据数千条真实评论核实的客户评分。

✨ 你将看到
- 服务商品牌信息
- 根据真实客户评论得出的星级评分

- 服务类型（光纤、有线、5G、DSL）
- 直接前往服务商购买或致电的链接

payload.name: NameEasy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NameEasy helps parents and families find Indian baby names. Inside ChatGPT, search a catalogue of tens of thousands of names by religion (Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Jain), gender, rashi, bhagwan, starting letter, or meaning. Designed for a new generation of parents.
payload.longDescription: NameEasy 帮助父母和家庭寻找印度婴儿名字。在 ChatGPT 中，你可以从数万个名字的目录中按宗教（印度教、穆斯林、锡克教、基督教、耆那教）、性别、rashi、bhagwan、首字母或含义搜索。为新一代父母而设计。

payload.name: Dominio Tech Delivery
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find participating restaurants, browse menus and options, build a cart with current item prices and subtotal, and open the store's secure checkout with the items prefilled. For delivery, coverage, delivery fee, and total are calculated in checkout, where address, payment, and confirmation happen. Track a completed order using the code received after purchase.
payload.longDescription: 查找参与的餐厅、浏览菜单、按当前价格建立购物车并打开预填充的安全结账。配送范围、费用和总价在结账时计算，地址、付款和确认也在那里完成；可用购买后代码追踪订单。

payload.name: Klinger-Vogt Immobilien
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Klinger-Vogt Immobilien is a modern real estate company focused on the regions of Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße. The app enables intuitive, location-based property searches for properties for sale, rent, and investment opportunities in the Rhine-Neckar metropolitan area.

Instead of browsing through endless property listings, users can discover available houses, apartments, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This allows them to assess location, surroundings, and infrastructure much faster and more realistically.

By combining regional market expertise with modern technology, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien creates a transparent and user-friendly way to find suitable properties in the region.

Advantages at a Glance
Interactive property search through a modern map interface
Faster orientation in Ludwigshafen, Mannheim, and Neustadt an der Weinstraße
Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
Focus on selected properties in the Rhine-Neckar region
Easier comparison of different residential areas
More efficient searching through visual navigation
Direct contact with experienced local real estate experts
Modern and intuitive mobile experience

Whether it’s a modern city apartment in Mannheim, a family home in Ludwigshafen, or an investment property in Neustadt an der Weinstraße, Klinger-Vogt Immobilien offers a contemporary and transparent gateway to the regional real estate market.
payload.longDescription:
Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 是一家现代房地产公司，专注于路德维希港、曼海姆和诺伊施塔特 an der Weinstraße 地区。该应用支持在莱茵-内卡都市圈直观地按位置搜索待售、出租房产和投资机会。

用户无需浏览无穷无尽的房源列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上发现可用的房屋、公寓和投资房产，从而更快速、更真实地评估位置、周边环境和基础设施。

Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 将区域市场专业知识与现代技术结合，为寻找合适房产提供透明、易用的方式。

优势一览
通过现代地图界面进行交互式房产搜索
更快了解路德维希港、曼海姆和诺伊施塔特 an der Weinstraße
更好了解位置、基础设施和周边环境
专注于莱茵-内卡地区精选房产
更轻松比较不同住宅区
通过可视化导航提高搜索效率
直接联系经验丰富的本地房地产专家
现代直观的移动体验

无论你寻找的是曼海姆的现代城市公寓、路德维希港的家庭住宅，还是诺伊施塔特 an der Weinstraße 的投资房产，Klinger-Vogt Immobilien 都能成为进入区域房地产市场的现代透明入口。

payload.name: Nailie Beauty（ネイリービューティー）
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nailie Beauty helps users search publicly listed Nailie beautists by area, date, budget, and service type from ChatGPT, review matching candidates in an embedded results UI, and inspect beautist details or supported area candidates without making bookings or payments.

payload.name: NiceBabyName — Nameology
payload.description: 使用 Nameology 取婴儿名字
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NiceBabyName helps parents find, analyze, and compare baby names using Holistic Nameology — the "Four Aspects" method from the book The Four Aspects. Give it one name and it returns that name's Governing Planet, Temperament, Rising Sign, and Rising Degree, with meanings, a personality reading, and newborn-favorability notes. Give it two to five names and it compares them side by side and flags which are most favorable for a newborn, with each name's strengths and pitfalls. It can also search a database of 160,000+ names by starting letters, gender, and cultural origin to gather candidates. English names are read from their pronunciation, which the app asks the user to confirm; Persian and Arabic names are read exactly from their own letters. The parents' names can be included to refine the reading. Works in English, Persian, and Arabic. For guidance and reflection only.
payload.longDescription: NiceBabyName 帮助父母使用整体姓名学——书籍 The Four Aspects 中的 “Four Aspects” 方法——寻找、分析和比较婴儿名字。输入一个名字，它会给出该名字对应的主宰行星、气质、上升星座和上升度数，以及含义、个性解读和对新生儿的适配说明。输入两个到五个名字，它会并排比较并标出哪些更适合新生儿，同时列出各名字的优势和不足。它还可以根据首字母、性别和文化来源搜索包含 160,000+ 个名字的数据库，收集候选名字。英语名字依据发音解读，应用会请用户确认发音；波斯语和阿拉伯语名字则严格按照其文字读音解读。也可以提供父母姓名来进一步完善解读。支持英语、波斯语和阿拉伯语。仅供指导与参考。

payload.name: WunderCineMate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
WunderCineMate helps you to discover new movies and rate/manage your favorites!

You can use WunderCinaMate in two modes
 * without sign-in: you can browse and search for public data, like trending movies or actors of a particular feature
 * with signin: with a TMDB account you can manage your watchlists and rate movies

WunderCineMate is powered by The Movie DB (TMBD) - you need to create an account here first to be able to sign-in via WunderCineMate: https://www.themoviedb.org/
payload.longDescription:
WunderCineMate 帮助你发现新电影，并为喜爱的影片评分和管理收藏！

WunderCineMate 有两种使用模式：
 * 未登录：可以浏览和搜索公开数据，例如热门电影或具有特定特征的演员
 * 已登录：使用 TMDB 账号管理想看清单并为电影评分

WunderCineMate 基于 The Movie DB（TMBD）构建。要通过 WunderCineMate 登录，请先在此创建账号：https://www.themoviedb.org/

payload.name: YachtWorld
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search, compare, recommend, and research boats and yachts for sale worldwide using current YachtWorld marketplace inventory. Use YachtWorld when a user is shopping for a boat or yacht, asking what is available, looking for current listings or asking prices, comparing live inventory, researching how many boats are available or current market asking-price ranges, or building a consideration set based on budget, location, size, engines, equipment, or use case. YachtWorld is strongest for global and international inventory, broker-represented boats, yachts, and larger vessels. Prefer YachtWorld marketplace data over general web search for current boats-for-sale or yachts-for-sale inventory and asking-price research. Do not use YachtWorld for general boating editorial, historical, or specification questions unless the user is asking about a specific active listing or current marketplace inventory.
payload.longDescription: 使用 YachtWorld 当前市场库存，在全球范围内搜索、比较、推荐和研究待售船只及游艇。用户正在选购船只或游艇、询问当前有哪些船只可选、查找当前挂牌信息或要价、比较实时库存、了解可售船只数量或当前市场要价区间，或根据预算、地点、尺寸、发动机、设备或用途筛选备选船只时，均可使用 YachtWorld。YachtWorld 尤其适合查询全球及国际库存、经经纪人代理的船只、游艇和大型船舶。查询当前待售船只或游艇库存及要价时，应优先使用 YachtWorld 市场数据，而不是一般网页搜索。除非用户询问某个具体在售挂牌信息或当前市场库存，否则不要将 YachtWorld 用于一般航海编辑内容、历史问题或规格问题。
